MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 29

2. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 7

3. Solve for x: x + 7 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 6
   C. 13
   D. 7

4. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 72
   C. 1
   D. 17

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 19
   C. 23
   D. 7

6. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 9

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

11. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 22

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

15. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
